06

Before you fly出发前准备Passport & Entry护照与入境

↑ 顶部Top

Passport护照

Your passport must be valid for more than 6 months from the date you enter China.护照有效期须自入境中国之日起超过6个月。

Visa签证

Singapore passport holders can visit mainland China visa-free for up to 30 days. Other passport holders should check their own requirements. If you need a visa, apply at least 14 days before departure (about 5 working days to process).新加坡护照持有人可免签入境中国大陆最多30天。其他护照持有人请自行确认签证要求；如需签证，请至少在出发前14天申请（约需5个工作日）。

China Arrival Card中国入境卡

All passengers must fill in the China Arrival Card, either online before the flight or on arrival.所有旅客都须填写中国入境卡，可在出发前网上填写或抵达后填写。

Fill in online ↗网上填写 ↗

Customs & duty-free海关与免税额

  • Gifts, perfume and personal belongings should not exceed SGD 10,000 in value.礼品、香水及个人物品总值不超过 新币10,000。
  • Adults may bring in up to 2 bottles of alcohol and 400 cigarettes duty-free.成人可免税携带酒类2瓶及香烟400支。
  • Complete any customs declaration form given to you on arrival.如抵达时需填写海关申报表，请如实填写。

  • It is cold and dry. Mornings and evenings are much colder than the daytime high. Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (4,506 m) is freezing at the top.天气寒冷干燥，早晚温差大。玉龙雪山（4,506米）山顶非常寒冷。
  • Dress in layers: a sweater and a thick winter jacket, plus comfortable shoes with good grip. Bring sunglasses, moisturiser and lip balm for the strong sun and dry air.建议洋葱式穿搭：毛衣加厚外套，穿防滑舒适的鞋子。高原紫外线强、空气干燥，请带墨镜、润肤霜和润唇膏。

Temperatures are a guideline only. Please check the forecast closer to departure.以上气温仅供参考，出发前请留意天气预报。

09

Travel smart出行贴士Money, Health & Data付款、健康与上网

↑ 顶部Top

💴 Money & payments付款

  • Bring RMB cash. Credit cards work in big-city hotels and stores, but not everywhere.请携带人民币现金。大城市的酒店和商店可刷卡，但并非处处通用。
  • Most shops use Alipay or WeChat Pay. If you want to use them, link your card in the app before departure.当地商家普遍使用支付宝或微信支付。如需使用，请在出发前绑定银行卡。
  • Never change money with strangers on the street. It is illegal and you risk being robbed.切勿在街头与陌生人换钱，属违法行为且有被抢风险。

🍵 Health健康

  • Do not drink tap water. Drink boiled or bottled water. One bottle per person per day is provided.请勿饮用自来水，请喝开水或瓶装水。每人每天提供1瓶矿泉水。
  • Bring basic medicine (cold, cough, diarrhoea) and your personal medication, and keep them in your cabin bag.请携带感冒、咳嗽、腹泻等常备药及个人药物，并放在手提行李中。
  • Oxygen canisters are sold at Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (about RMB 39) if you need one.玉龙雪山有氧气瓶出售（约人民币39元），可视需要购买。
📶 Mobile data: Google, WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram generally don't work on China's local networks and hotel Wi-Fi. Roaming from your Singapore telco, or an overseas eSIM, usually still works. Please set this up before departure so you can stay in touch with the group.📶 上网提醒：在中国当地网络及酒店Wi-Fi下，一般无法使用Google、WhatsApp、Facebook、Instagram。使用新加坡电信的漫游或海外eSIM通常可以正常使用，请在出发前开通，方便与团友保持联系。
🛡 Travel insurance: We strongly encourage comprehensive travel insurance covering medical emergencies, baggage loss, flight delays and travel agent insolvency. Save the assistance hotline on your phone.🛡 旅游保险：强烈建议购买全面旅游保险，涵盖医疗紧急情况、行李遗失、航班延误及旅行社倒闭等。请将保险公司援助热线存入手机。

Pack right行李须知Baggage & Reminders行李与重要提醒

↑ 顶部Top

Baggage allowance (MU)行李限额（东航）

  • Checked: 1 piece, 20 kg per person. Length + width + height must not exceed 158 cm.托运行李：每人1件，20公斤，长宽高总和不超过158厘米。
  • Cabin: 1 piece, max 7 kg, up to 56 × 36 × 23 cm.手提行李：1件，最多7公斤，尺寸不超过56 × 36 × 23厘米。
  • Cabin liquids must be in containers of 100 ml or less, in a transparent bag. Put sharp items (knives, scissors, razors) in checked baggage.手提液体每瓶须不超过100毫升，并装入透明袋。刀、剪刀、剃刀等尖锐物品请放托运行李。

🔋 Power banks充电宝

≤100WhCabin only仅限手提
100–160WhMax 2 pcs最多2个
>160WhNot allowed禁止携带
  • Power banks and lithium batteries go in your cabin bag only, never in checked baggage.充电宝及锂电池只能手提，不可托运。
  • Hoverboards, mini-Segways and balance wheels are not allowed at all.平衡车、电动滑板等一律不可携带。
🚄 Train day (Day 7, 18 Nov): Your big luggage travels to Kunming by bus, and you won't have it on the train. Pack a small day bag with your passport, medication, a warm layer, phone charger and anything you need for the evening.🚄 动车日（第7天，11月18日）：大件行李由巴士运回昆明，不能带上动车。请准备一个小背包，放护照、药物、保暖衣物、充电器及当晚需要的物品。
🇸🇬 Returning to Singapore: All passengers, including Singaporeans, must submit the SG Arrival Card online between 17 and 19 Nov 2026. Submission through ICA is free.🇸🇬 返回新加坡：所有旅客（包括新加坡公民）须在2026年11月17至19日之间网上提交SG Arrival Card（新加坡入境卡）。通过ICA官网提交免费。
